title: Review of Posterior Cruciate Ligament Injuries in Athletes.
journal: The Orthopedic clinics of North America

sections.label: UNLABELED
sections.text: This review synthesizes current knwledge. regarding posterior cruciate ligament (PCL) injuries in athletes, encompassing anatomical structure, biomechanical function, injury mechanisms, and diagnostic evaluation. We present an analaysis of both non-operative and operative management options, with particular attention to contemporary reconstruction techniques and recovery protocols. The review provides clinicians with an evidence-based framework for PCL injury management in athletic populations.
